noteEn: Private-party ads. These are not Mejor Vida Insurance prices or the cemetery’s official list. The office must transfer the deed. Check that the listing is still active.

cemeterySignals.noteEs: No publica el lote en la web. Anuncios de reventa en 2017–2026 citaron unos $1,295–$1,800 por espacio y hasta $5,000 por doble profundidad en secciones como Garden of the Apostles.
cemeterySignals.noteEn: They do not publish plot prices online. Resale ads in 2017–2026 cited about $1,295 to $1,800 per space and up to $5,000 for double depth in sections such as Garden of the Apostles.
